fields.label: Country/Region
fields.note: The only facet published by the search widget (fieldId custCountryRegion, label 'Country/Region'). Verified live: facetFilters {"custCountryRegion":["India"]} -> totalJobs 12,723 of 15,248.

fields.label: Location
fields.note: Free-text location field in the same request body; the search page pairs it with the country/region facet.

notes: HCLTech's careers entry leads to its SuccessFactors Career Site Builder search at https://careers.hcltech.com/search/ (input name='q', placeholder 'Search by Keyword'). The page posts to https://careers.hcltech.com/services/recruiting/v1/jobs with body {locale:'en_US', pageNumber, sortBy:'date', keywords, location, facetFilters, brand:'', skills:[], categoryId, alertId, rcmCandidateId} and returns totalJobs/jobSearchResult. Facets are passed in facetFilters as {fieldId: [values]}; the only configured facet is custCountryRegion. Sorting is server-side via sortBy (adapter uses date and reconciles newest-first ordering).
evidence: https://careers.hcltech.com/search/ (HTTP 200) -> <input type='search' name='q' aria-label='Search by Keyword'>

POST https://careers.hcltech.com/services/recruiting/v1/jobs {facetFields:['custCountryRegion'],facetingOnly:true} -> totalJobs 15,248; values India 12,723, United States 884, United Kingdom 206, Canada 121, Philippines 121 ...
